stories.title: Air Force One buzzes Neyland Stadium
stories.summary: Before Texas played Tennessee, Air Force One made a low pass over 100,000 fans at Neyland Stadium on Trump's way into Knoxville, and "Air Force One" was the top trend in the US. ESPN's broadcast said it came "REALLY close to the top of the stadium". The White House's flyover clip got 39K likes and CNN, barred from the plane that day, was replaced in the press pool by Real America's Voice. Texas won 20-17.
